title: scorecraft 0.1.0
text: First release. production-grade scorecard engine binary targets, built ‘OptimalBinningWoE’: audit funnel, single configuration, named relaxation, first-class scale alignment, cut-strategy hardened deliverables. Seven stages, exported function, chained scr_select() scr_scorecard(): scr_split(), scr_triage(), scr_bin(), scr_model(), scr_align(), scr_cutoff()/scr_strategy()/scr_reject(). scr_align() first-class stage: banded log-odds regression raw score composed PDO map, odds_orientation recorded, applied engine. runs automatically inside scr_scorecard(). scr_sql() emits production SQL fourteen dialects: pre-processing CTE, WOE/BIN transformation authoritative cut points , scorecard, exact score plus whole points bin index. R-SQL equivalence verified test DuckDB SQLite. Binning parallelised column (nthread), fits merged; result identical serial one. scr_metrics() always reports bootstrap confidence interval AUC/KS/Gini; scr_psi() reports fixed threshold next sample-size-adjusted critical value Yurdakul Naranjo (2020). tree challenger (xgboost lightgbm) can fitted WOE columns aligned scale, supports_scorecard = FALSE. scr_reject() implements honest reject inference: population scope, band coverage 2x/4x/8x sensitivity band, never parcelling default. scr_monitor() recomputes PSI/CSI (signed points shift) performance vintage new data; never schedules . scr_export() writes four hardened .xlsx workbooks (selection, scorecard, validation, strategy), SQL files Markdown summary. scr_coarse_classing() opens manual binning lab: scr_classing_view(), scr_classing_propose() (breaks, groups, merge, split, missing_to, other_to, reset), scr_classing_accept()/scr_classing_discard() mandatory reason, scr_classing_choose() (keep/drop/force), scr_classing_spec()/scr_classing_read()/scr_classing_import() CSV/xlsx round trip, scr_classing_apply() commit new scr_result, scr_decisions() append-ledger. Manual bins share engine’s contract, scr_scorecard(), scr_apply() scr_sql() follow unchanged; funnel gains provenance. scr_connect() accepts DBI driver next ODBC DSN, scr_fetch() samples server-side dialect-aware random expression.
